text_block_list.text:
Fu... ku... Come... to the storehouse...
Surely, someone like you...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Storehouse...? What do you mean?
Wait! Is that... a divine revelation...?!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Fungyaraaaagh!

While strolling through the academy grounds,
I spotted Machikane Fukukitaru frantically
plucking every flower in sight...!
choice_data_list: What in the world are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... D-Don't stop me!
This is all for the sake of grabbing happiness through my dream's revelation!!

Glancing at her feet, I noticed a single sheet of paper.
On it were drawings of flowers, dancing people,
and several numbers.
choice_data_list: Is that some kind of doodle...?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It is not! This is a "Ritual Diagram"!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
When I visited my family home, I received a revelation
in a dream telling me to "go to the storehouse," and upon searching...
I found this very paper!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It matched the dream's prophecy to the letter!
Which means this is a miraculously sacred ritual diagram!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Though the diagrams are quite arcane,
I will decipher them without fail, complete the ritual,
and rake in heaps of divine blessings~~~!

...Worried as she dashed off in hyperactive excitement,
I decided to follow and keep an eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-hmmm-hum♪
Sprinkling chrysanthemum petals, tra-la-la♪
Boiled with greens...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oho, chrysanthemums!
Come to think of it, doesn't that resemble the flower in the ritual diagram?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Which means—here I go!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek?! F-Fuku-chan-senpai?!
Those are my Kikku-chans!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*gulp*... N-Now that's d-done...
Urp! It's bubbling back up...!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next step...
Running along the course while dancing!!
Just as the Sacred Ritual Diagram commands~♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Fukukitaru is doing
something hilarious again, YES!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wonder when we'll actually get to run...?

Despite my attempts to restrain her after that,
Machikane Fukukitaru continued causing
commotions all across the grounds...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I understand the situation. However,
ignoring your Trainer's warnings and causing trouble
for other students cannot be overlooked.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeth... I'm thorrrry...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Auuu... I meant to seize good fortune...
but now I'm stuck in terrible misfortune... What should I do...?
choice_data_list: ...Are you sure that's actually a ritual diagram?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course, absolutely—... wait, surely?
...Probably..................
...H-Hold on a second, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Fukukitaru's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"—Just as I thought, neither Papa nor Grandma
knows anything about a ritual diagram in the storehouse~.
I mean, we don't keep sacred ritual items in the storehouse anyway."

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
............So Mom, Dad,
and Grandma all have no clue...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Then what on earth IS thaaaat thing?!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No clue? Even though it was tucked away in the storehouse
looking so terribly important?!
Who? Who put it in a place like that?!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It makes no sense that nobody knows about ittt!
Noooo! What in the world is thaaat?!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's the ultimate secret art of fortune?!
...Maybe it's something that was meant to stay sealed.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
!!!!!
T-The ultimate secret art of fortune, you say?!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-I see now?!
If it's an esoteric art of the highest tier, then it's totally
natural that nobody knows about the diagram!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Panicking over nothing was a waste of energy~!
Let's pick another day to unravel this grand mystery!

I couldn't help but feel impressed, in a way,
by how quickly Machikane Fukukitaru bounced back...

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Nyaa-n!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
!? D-Did a black cat just cross in front of me
right now?! Could that be a harbinger of doom?
A divine warning telling me not to meddle any further?!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeeek~!
Save me, Shiraoki-samaaa~!

I could only watch in stunned silence as she
sprinted away in the blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
!!!
I knew it! I knew that had to be it!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, I have to put it back in the storehouse!
Before that, appease the spirits?!
Abra-kadabra seal away begone begoneee!!

...Ah, jeez...
Still, you'll reach it someday. Because...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I feel like a warm glow just washed over me!
Could that mean the spirit successfully became
a gentle guardian soul?

Still perplexed, I nodded noncommittally.
Whose voice was that just now?
We parted ways wrapped in a mysterious mood...
